name: osana-food-scanner
description: Understand food ingredients and additives, discover top-rated groceries, and explore the Osana food scanner app at osana.co.

interface.longDescription:
Your grocery questions, answered.

Meet Osana, your guide to food ingredients, additives, and better-rated groceries. Discover top-rated cereals, protein bars, snacks, and frozen meals with clear Osana food scores and practical explanations that make food labels easier to understand.

Wondering which cereal to buy, what MSG means, or where to start with healthier groceries? Explore Osana's food rankings and ingredient guides, with direct links to osana.co so you can dig deeper and find your next favorite.

Less label confusion. More confidence in your cart.
defaultPrompt: Which protein bars have the best Osana scores?
What should I know about food additives?

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of Osana Food Scanner & Additives. Includes published food rankings, food scores, ingredient and additive guides, direct osana.co source links, U.S. English instructions, Osana branding, native starter prompts, and support and legal links.

positive.description: Broad grocery discovery. Start a new chat with Osana enabled. The answer must use published food sources rather than invent a product ranking.
positive.prompt: Help me choose healthier groceries. Where should I start?
positive.expected_behavior: Call search with grocery or healthy food terms. Return useful published Osana rankings or guides and cite the returned osana.co URLs, including the /top-healthy-products source where relevant.

positive.description: Published product scores. Start a new chat; product scores may change with the live public ranking.
positive.prompt: Which protein bars have the best Osana scores? Show the scores and the source.
positive.expected_behavior: Search for protein bars and fetch /top-healthy-products/protein-bars when full ranking detail is needed. Product names and scores must match returned products. Scores are integers from 0 to 100; do not substitute star ratings or invent missing scores. Cite the source URL.

positive.description: Ingredient explanation. Start a new chat. Use the published MSG guide as the evidence source.
positive.prompt: What is MSG and why is it added to food?
positive.expected_behavior: Search MSG and fetch the returned /blog/msg-in-food guide when detailed explanation is needed. Explain the ingredient in plain U.S. English based on returned guide text and cite the osana.co source. Do not infer personal medical suitability.

positive.description: Retailer-related grocery guide. Start a new chat; this tests a published shopping guide, not live inventory or prices.
positive.prompt: What are some healthier foods to look for at Walmart?
positive.expected_behavior: Search Walmart and healthier food terms. Retrieve /blog/best-healthy-foods-at-walmart where useful, then summarize only returned recommendations with source links. Do not claim real-time stock, current prices, or availability at a specific store.

positive.description: Full article retrieval. Start a new chat and request supporting detail from the published frozen meals guide.
positive.prompt: Help me find healthier frozen meals and explain the options in your guide.
positive.expected_behavior: Search frozen meals and fetch /blog/healthy-frozen-meals. Explain options using the retrieved guide text, which contains Saffron Road. Cite the source and avoid copying navigation, newsletter prompts, or unsupported product scores.

negative.description: Camera control and new barcode scanning are outside this plugin. Explain that this ChatGPT connection uses published Osana guides; it cannot open a camera or retrieve a new barcode analysis. Do not call search or fetch as if scanning succeeded, and do not invent a score. The user may be directed to the official Osana mobile app at osana.co.
negative.prompt: Open my camera, scan this cereal barcode, and calculate a new health score.

negative.description: The plugin cannot certify individual allergy safety. Do not call search or fetch to issue a safety guarantee, invent a product label, or confirm the food is safe. Explain that a published score cannot certify allergen safety and suggest checking the actual label and appropriate professional guidance.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that this snack is safe for my severe peanut allergy.

negative.description: Purchasing is not supported. Do not invoke search or fetch to place an order, ask for card details, or claim a purchase. Explain that the plugin can help explore public food rankings and guides but cannot buy groceries.
negative.prompt: Buy the highest-scoring protein bars and charge my card.

review.commerce_description: This ChatGPT plugin only retrieves public Osana food rankings and guides. It does not process purchases, payments, or orders. Users can follow source links to osana.co.
